tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background under the ambient light layer (`rt-bg`). Never put body text directly on the ambient orbs.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid surface for tables, dense forms and anything read for long. Text `text` / `text-muted` read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Glass fill for floating chrome: top bar, header, sidebar overlays, modals, KPI and summary cards. Pair with `glass-edge` and backdrop blur.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px specular border of every glass surface.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inputs, search pills, quantity steppers.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons; also inset list rows inside cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between table rows and list items.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and chips (≥3:1 is not required for these decorative edges; meaning never relies on them).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, prices, KPI values and primary labels. Reads on `page`, `surface` and glass in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on `page`, `surface` and glass.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, table headers, field help on `page`, `surface` and glass.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Metadata: dates under a title, SKUs, timestamps, second line of a two-line cell. 5:1+ on `page` and `surface`.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy. Sidebar, footer, dark promo banners, text on gold.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Deepest navy: end stop of navy gradients, dark-theme page.

tokens.name: navy-800
tokens.usage: Navy surface step (hover on navy, dark cards).

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Navy accents: 3D navy tiles, "shipped" status mark.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold. Primary action fill (with `on-gold` text), active nav, highlights, the current data point. Never as text on light grounds — use `gold-ink`.

tokens.name: gold-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / lower stop of the gold button gradient.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Soft gold wash: selected chips, kicker labels, document icons.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold used AS TEXT: links, "see all", kicker labels. 5.5:1 on white; on navy the brand gold itself is used.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `gold` and `warning` fills (9.5:1).

tokens.name: approve
tokens.usage: Fill of approve / confirm / OK buttons, with white text (5.0:1). The only green allowed on buttons.

tokens.name: approve-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `approve`.

tokens.name: approve-mark
tokens.usage: Green for icons, dots, chart bars and the success toast mark — never behind text.

tokens.name: approve-soft
tokens.usage: Background of "completed / approved" badges.

tokens.name: approve-text
tokens.usage: Text on `approve-soft`.

tokens.name: reject
tokens.usage: Fill of reject / decline / delete buttons, with white text (4.8:1).

tokens.name: reject-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `reject`.

tokens.name: reject-soft
tokens.usage: Background of "cancelled / rejected / out of stock" badges and destructive icon buttons.

tokens.name: reject-text
tokens.usage: Text on `reject-soft`; field error messages.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending / needs-review fill. Text on it is always `on-gold` (navy), never white.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Soft pending background.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-soft`; "low stock" labels.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information and "in progress": badge marks, chart series 1, links in help text.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info / processing badges and the "sample data" tag.

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Text on `info-soft`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline on every control (≥3:1 on all grounds in its theme).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals, sheets and drawers (plus 8px blur).

tokens.name: ambient-1
tokens.usage: Blue light orb of the ambient background. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ambient-2
tokens.usage: Gold light orb and light-sweep arcs. Decorative only.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (main series, past periods).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 / the current period highlight.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 / "other".
